lead_story.headline: Atlanta Braves 2, Chicago White Sox 0
paragraphs: The Atlanta Braves defeated the Chicago White Sox 2–0 at Rate Field. Their biggest offensive inning came in the 3rd, when the Atlanta Braves scored 1 run.
ATL finished with 8 hits, while CWS collected 1. Riley, A led ATL with 2 hits and 2 RBI; Benintendi led CWS with 1 hit.
Grant Holmes earned the win. Anthony Kay took the loss. Raisel Iglesias recorded the save.
The game lasted 2:22; the announced crowd was 17,052.

around_the_league.headline: How rare is a 15-HR year at Double-A as a teen? Cards prospect joins star-studded list
around_the_league.deck: Dating back to 2006, just six players have hit 15 or home runs at Double-A before turning 20 years old. Rainiel Rodriguez became No. 6 on Thursday night, joining a list that includes Giancarlo Stanton, Fernando Tatis Jr., Jackson Chourio, Samuel Basallo and Leo De Vries (MLB’s No. 2 prospect).
